rows.notes: The study is a review (journal section labelled 'Review'; abstract states the paper reviews operational optical remote-sensing methods for crop water requirements and gives an overview of web-GIS tools). It reports no own experiment, survey, or validated model runs. Statements about satellite-based advisory services reflecting actual canopy conditions, covering large areas and improving water use (Sections 3.2-3.3, Table 2) are synthesised from cited sources (e.g., IRRISAT 18% water savings attributed to ref. 144; Vuolo et al. 2015). Figure 2 (NDVI time series for Albacete 2016) and Figure 4 (AEMET ETo forecast map) are illustrative displays, not results on the claimed effect. Therefore Q1 is 'no' and Q2-Q9 are 'no'.

notes: Full text appears complete, with some OCR duplication of pages 4-5, 14 and 17. The document is a review article, so it cannot provide primary evidence for the claim.
